root=Path("/media/sangfor/vdb/legal-skill-evolve");run=root/"runs/legal_openexempt_ace_public_assets128_20261021_run01"
def rd(p): return json.loads(p.read_text())
def h(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert not Path("/proc/1738522").exists()

 p=Path(a["path"]);assert h(p)==a["sha256"]
 with tarfile.open(p,"r:gz") as tf:

  assert len(members)==receipt["files"]==955
  for m in members:
   target=root/m.name
   with tf.extractfile(m) as f: assert hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()==h(target),m.name
 archives.append({"path":str(p),"sha256":a["sha256"],"members":len(members),"all_original_runtime_bytes_exact":True})

diag=copy.deepcopy(records["ace"]);case_changes=[]
for r in diag:
 if r["parse_error"]=="ValueError('Repeated native bullet provenance')":
  row=rows[r["case_id"],r["family"]]
  raw=rd(root/r["raw_call_path"]);submitted=json.loads(raw["response"]["content"])
  _,schema=generator_payload(row,book,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
  validate(submitted,schema)
  assert len(submitted["bullet_ids"])>len(set(submitted["bullet_ids"]))
  final=decode_classification(decode_asset_references(submitted["final_answer"],public_asset_catalog(row)),public_catalog(row))
  target=rd(root/cfg["grading_directory"]/f'{r["case_id"]}.json')["targets"][r["family"]]
  corrected=evaluate(row,final,target)
  case_changes.append({"case":r["case_id"],"family":r["family"],"raw_path":r["raw_call_path"],
   "raw_sha256":h(root/r["raw_call_path"]),"raw_reported_ids":submitted["bullet_ids"],
   "original_legacy_F1":r["score"]["f1"],"unchanged_legal_answer_only_F1":corrected["f1"],
   "JSON_schema_already_accepts_duplicate_IDs":True,"raw_prediction_and_original_score_not_modified":True})
  r["score"]=corrected
assert len(case_changes)==2
native=[]
for p in (run/"native").rglob("*.json"):
 if p.name.endswith((".input.json",".answer.json")):continue
 d=rd(p)
 if "calls" in d:
  assert len(d["calls"])==1 and d["transport_error"] is None
  native.append(d)
assert len(native)==failure["actual_native_calls"]==177

assert len(teachers)==failure["actual_teacher_responses"]==56
